game.title: Pokémon Ruby
game.revision_note: These codes were verified against US v1.0 (the most common ROM). v1.1/v1.2 use different addresses — failures on those revisions are documented for several codes. Note: Ruby codes are NOT interchangeable with Sapphire.

codes.name: Master Code (GameShark v3 / AR v3)
codes.description: Must-be-on master code for Ruby US on GameShark v3 / Action Replay v3 — the device generation Delta emulates. Add as its own cheat and enable it first. Do not mix with codes written for older device firmware.

codes.name: Master Code (older GameShark / Action Replay)
codes.description: Master code for pre-v3 devices. Only needed if a code you're using came from an older-device list — codes from the v3 set and this set are NOT interchangeable.

codes.name: Walk Through Walls
codes.description: Walk over any obstacle (trees, houses, rocks) and on water.
side_effects: Easy to get stuck in unreachable map areas — don't save there.
Reported to stay active after disabling until you save and reload the game.
Reported NOT to work on v1.1 ROMs.

codes.name: Rare Candy in PC
codes.description: Puts Rare Candies in PC item storage. If it doesn't work, enable the Master Code too, or try the alternate version below.
codes.activation: Pokémon Center PC → Item Storage → Withdraw
side_effects: Save before applying; if a bad egg or glitch appears, do NOT save.
Enable only one cheat at a time to avoid freezes.

codes.name: Rare Candy in PC (alternate)
codes.description: Alternate Rare Candy PC code from a different code set. Requires the v3 Master Code enabled.
codes.activation: Pokémon Center PC → Item Storage → Withdraw
side_effects: Use one Rare Candy code at a time, not both.

codes.name: Master Ball in PC
codes.description: Puts Master Balls in PC item storage. Listed standalone by one source; if it fails, enable the v3 Master Code.
codes.activation: Pokémon Center PC → Item Storage → Withdraw

codes.name: Infinite Money
codes.description: Infinite money. If it doesn't work, enable the Master Code too.
side_effects: On some emulators the money display caps at 3,000 until you spend some.

codes.name: Shiny Wild Pokémon
codes.description: Wild Pokémon appear shiny while enabled.
side_effects: Turn the cheat OFF before catching, or the caught Pokémon keeps a glitched name.
If a bad egg or glitch appears, do NOT save.

codes.name: No Random Battles
codes.description: Disables wild encounters. Remember to disable it to encounter Pokémon again.
